نتخابر (form VI)
# نَتَخَابَرُ (nataḵābaru) /na.ta.xaː.ba.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَخَابَرَ (taḵābara)
# نَتَخَابَرَ (nataḵābara) /na.ta.xaː.ba.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَخَابَرَ (taḵābara)
# نَتَخَابَرْ (nataḵābar) /na.ta.xaː.bar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَخَابَرَ (taḵābara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
